investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on a suspicious domain (vtl-a8f2-x91z.net) by the Logo-Scanner. The scanned URL leads to a login-like page that imitates Vitalis Healthcare's Unified Secure Login, suggesting possible credential harvesting. The domain is only 25 days old, resolves to 45.138.27.112, and is registered with NIC.xyz, which is typical of newly created infrastructure used for phishing. Overall, this logo-based impersonation on a newly registered domain constitutes a high-risk activity requiring rapid investigation.
